propuesta.prompt: @image1 is a real photo of penne arrabiata at a restaurant. Use it only as the list of elements, not as a layout to copy. The new photograph must contain the same real elements: ridged penne rigate pasta coated in glossy red tomato sauce; cooked red tomato chunks and crushed red chili flakes; fine strands of pale shredded cheese on the pasta and plate rim; one dark blue-black speckled stoneware bowl; one dark matte fluted underplate. Exactly 1 × one dark blue-black speckled stoneware bowl; 1 × one dark matte fluted underplate. Nothing else added. New composition by a professional food photographer: slightly high three-quarter view rotated around the dish, showing the whole bowl and fluted underplate centered in the lower half with generous margin on all sides, 50 mm lens at f/5.6, the whole dish and dark tableware sit intact in the lower center over a plain uniform white-grey surface for clean cutout, leaving wide empty space above for the stacked headline behind the bowl, on a clean, plain, uniform background with even light around the whole dish, so it can be cut out cleanly. Bright 5000 K directional studio side light like a large window, illuminating one side more than the other, casting a crisp soft-edged contact shadow with neutral white balance, neutral white-grey background and dark tableware making the saturated orange-red tomato pasta the sole strong color. Overall aesthetic: bright, even studio light with crisp contact shadows; a clean, plain, uniform background that makes the dish easy to cut out; no props: only the dish on its real tableware; saturated, punchy colours; the whole dish inside the frame, not cut by any edge, from a slightly high three-quarter view. Luz natural de una ventana lateral, balance de día neutro de unos 5000 K. Sombras direccionales de borde suave con detalle, como en una mesa junto a la ventana. Una parte del plato recibe más luz que la otra. Conserva el color de los materiales, como la tela teja y la loza clara en una sesión editorial casera. Balance de blancos neutro. La loza blanca y el lino claro conservan su tono neutro, incluso si la escena tiene materiales de color. Los dorados pertenecen a la cocción y a la corteza, los rojos o marrones a los materiales que los tienen. Corrige una dominante amarilla, ámbar o naranja que tiña toda la imagen, incluso si aparece en una foto de referencia. Photographic realism, no text. Editorial direction: Keep the upper part quiet for a large masthead. Let the top edge of the dish reach the lower edge of that space. Keep the characteristic colours of the ingredients consistent. Render no lettering or graphics.
